hypothesis: Explicit question-target and source-relation guidance improves answer quality at unchanged visible evidence and one call.
gate_basis: Decision thresholds for this bounded engineering trial, not universal research standards; +3pp minimum useful F1 and positive grouped CI, no EM/deletion/refusal regression, modest one-call overhead.
source_policy: All original messages except exactly one trusted answer instruction unchanged. Negative cases only remove reviewed original records and matching refs. All requests re-admitted without truncation.
reuse_policy: Exact same-run same-arm messages share one physical outcome including failures; no historical answers as primary control.
failure_policy: Every planned case retained; errors score0, never successful refusal. Stop new dispatch on unknown outcome/model mismatch/non400 provider error or5 invalid/known400 results; await in-flight, no retry.
primary: Development160 original-context token F1 across official aliases; grouped paired95 bootstrap by original source group.
contrast_policy: 4 historical reviewed pairs plus first eligible source-reviewed additions, selected without new output access. Curated guard only; no population accuracy claim.
semantic_policy: No automatic semantic judge used. Curated relations reviewed before calls; official F1/EM and citation identity separate from semantic support.
confirmation: Only if all development gates pass, freeze this one candidate and evaluate a fresh question/source-disjoint sample. Previous dev confirmation sets are exposed and cannot count as blind.
stop_policy: No same-cohort prompt search, automatic rewrites, example variant or model/budget changes. Failure ends this milestone with baseline retained.
production: No global default/production QA change in this milestone; controlled short-answer evidence does not certify business E2E.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
